title: Lilica: A Small Bag. A Big Heart.
seoTitle: Lilica: The Dog Who Shared Her Dinner | BHOC Initiative
description: The true story of Lilica, a dog in Brazil who brought food home for other animals. A short BHOC Initiative reflection on friendship, instinct and care.
genre: Historical animal-welfare story and personal reflection
keywords: dog shares food with other animals
deck: A true story from São Carlos, Brazil, reported in 2012. One dog and a daily act of care across species.

images.alt: Lilica beside a caregiver and a tied bag of food at night, in the original 2012 TV Globo report from São Carlos, Brazil.
images.caption: Lilica and a bag of food in the original Brazilian television report, 2012.

galleryLabel: Lilica in the original Brazilian television report
paragraphs: In São Carlos, Brazil, Lilica carried food home each evening for the animals who shared her scrapyard home: another dog, a cat, chickens and a mule.
Teacher Lúcia Helena de Souza fed her and tied up the food bag. Neile Vânia Antônio, who had taken Lilica in after she was abandoned, opened it for the others. Care passed from one life to another.
For me, these are friends who think, share and care.
principle: Some will call it instinct. I say: may we all have an instinct like hers, and a soul like hers.
closing: Their lives deserve our respect and protection.
